record.issue_text: Unhandled nil i.content in poll_feed feed parsing — i.content.scrub raises NoMethodError for Atom feeds lacking content, permanently failing the polling job with retry: false

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `poll_feed` unconditionally does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. If `i.content` is `nil` for any parsed item, this will raise `NoMethodError` on `nil.scrub`, aborting the job. The job is configured with `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so a single such item would cause the polling run to fail without retries.
